stages.headline: Theorem: all points of one of two parallel lines are equally far from the other line.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: all points of one of two parallel lines are equally far from the other line.

stages.headline: That common distance is called the distance between the parallel lines.
stages.headlineEnglish: That common distance is called the distance between the parallel lines.

stages.headline: Conversely, points on one side of a line at the same distance from it lie on a line parallel to it.
stages.headlineEnglish: Conversely, points on one side of a line at the same distance from it lie on a line parallel to it.
